slides.title: WeExalate Dev Solutions
slides.narration: Welcome — this is WeExalate Dev Solutions, a web and SEO agency from Valsad, India. We build websites that actually work: fast, beautiful, and built to rank. Let me walk you through who we are and what we've shipped.

slides.title:
Web + SEO agency from Valsad,
building websites that actually work
slides.narration: A quick introduction. WeExalate is a web and SEO agency based in Valsad, Gujarat. Since 2019 we've shipped more than eighty-five projects and generated over four crore rupees in client revenue, with a ninety-eight percent client retention rate.

slides.title: Every digital need, expertly handled
slides.narration: We do four things. Web development on WordPress, Shopify and Webflow. Custom development — SaaS platforms, internal tools and API-first systems on Next.js, React and Node.js. Data-driven SEO that moves rankings that matter. And UI/UX design where every interaction is intentional.

slides.title: Work that moves the numbers
slides.narration: We don't just build websites — we build businesses. For Vrajesh Textiles in Surat, a Shopify store plus SEO tripled online revenue in ninety days — they now process over eighteen lakh rupees a month. For Dharmatech, an HR-tech SaaS in Ahmedabad, we shipped a Next.js site with a 99 Lighthouse score that converts at six point eight percent.

slides.title: Clients on working with WeExalate
slides.narration: Don't take our word for it. Vrajesh Patel calls us a revenue channel, not a website vendor. Neha Gohil from Dharmatech says that's a growth partner, not a web agency. Rajan Doshi and Sonal Trivedi will tell you about speed, quality and SEO results that show up in months, not years.

slides.title: From idea to launch — and beyond
slides.narration: How we work: a one-to-two-hour discovery call, a full strategy and proposal within two or three days, design and build over three to eight weeks with weekly check-ins, a week of QA before launch, and ongoing growth support after. Everything is quoted upfront — no surprises, ever.

slides.title: Things we've built
slides.narration: Here's a sample of what we've built — all open on GitHub and most live in production. EnerOS, an AI energy manager. Window PMS, a manufacturing ERP. Image Extractor. PropDesk, a real estate CRM. And a full-stack product catalog.

slides.title: EnerOS
slides.narration: First up: EnerOS — the autonomous energy manager for Britain's small and medium businesses. It reads your bills, checks every line against your contract and a published reference, and watches your sites so waste shows up before it reaches your P and L. A web and mobile console sharing one source of truth.
That is EnerOS live — the bill audit screen flags every deviation from the contract, and every saving is estimated or verified against a baseline. Never an unsupported claim.

slides.title: Window PMS
slides.narration: Window PMS — a production-grade production management system for window manufacturing. Orders move through tasks, alerts and a kanban board, with role-based access control, threaded comments and push notifications. Built on Next.js with MongoDB, Clerk auth and Firebase messaging.
The Window PMS repository — a hundred and thirteen commits of production TypeScript.

slides.title: Image Extractor
slides.narration: Image Extractor — an internal tool that pulls images off the web four ways: from a page URL, pasted HTML, bulk URLs, or stock-photo search across Unsplash, Pexels and Pixabay. Everything lands in one gallery with filters and a bulk ZIP pipeline.
The Image Extractor repository — TypeScript end to end.

slides.title: PropDesk
slides.narration: PropDesk — a full-featured real estate CRM. Revenue pipeline dashboards, property listings, lead scoring on a Kanban pipeline, calendar-based visit scheduling, payment tracking and unified global search. Built with Next.js, MongoDB, Clerk and Recharts.
The PropDesk repository — dark-first UI with a sidebar layout and role-based access control.

slides.title: Product Catalog
slides.narration: Product Catalog — a full-stack catalog where you add items, upload images and share links with anyone. No external database, no cloud storage — one server does it all.
The Product Catalog repository — Next.js fourteen with a zero-dependency storage design.

slides.title: Where can AI genuinely help your business?
slides.narration: We also offer AI consultations. Before you spend on any AI tool, we review how work actually flows through your team. We recommend where AI genuinely helps, and where it does not. And we run one small, focused pilot before you invest further.

slides.title: Practical uses for everyday business work
slides.narration: Where does AI actually help? Automation: drafting quotes, invoices and replies from your own data. Insight: spotting patterns in sales, stock and orders. Support: answering common questions quickly, with a person in the loop. And knowledge: finding answers across manuals, policies and past orders in seconds.
